note: Source: De Lacy O'Leary, The Daily Office and Theotokia of the Coptic Church (London, 1911), public domain. Sequence follows O'Leary's own numbered items (1)-(12) for the Morning Office, framed by the shared opening/closing formulas he documents as common to every hour. Psalms are resolved from this app's own verified Bible corpus (O'Leary cites references only, never his own psalm translations) -- see the rubric's psalms field. The lesson at item (2) (Ephesians 4:1-6) is likewise resolved from the corpus, not transcribed from O'Leary.

psalms.note: O'Leary p.89: 'Psalm 50 (51). Morning Psalms 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 10 (11), 11 (12), 12 (13), 14 (15), 17 (18).' Numbers here are converted to this app's Hebrew-numbered PSALM keys (O'Leary's Septuagint/Vulgate numbers are given in his own parentheses); 'fixed' is read first, then 'set' in order.
